title: Welcome to Null Meridian Labs
body: You're the new technical director. This banner will walk you through training and releasing your first model. Skip any step, or the whole thing, whenever you like.

title: Step 1 — Build compute
body: Open Build (bottom bar) and place a Server Rack. Training a model needs free compute headroom.

title: Step 2 — Hire someone
body: Open Staff and hire a candidate. Any role can be assigned to work — Engineers are strongest at training.

title: Step 3 — Train a model
body: Open Models, start a training project, then go to Staff > Inspect > Assign to put your new hire on the Training Run task at the rack you built.

title: Step 4 — Evaluate it (optional)
body: Open Models and evaluate your trained model to reveal its true safety and capability range before shipping. Optional, but recommended — skip if you'd rather ship blind.

title: Step 5 — Release it
body: Open Models and click Deploy on your trained model. That's a release.

title: You shipped your first model
body: That's the whole loop: build, hire, train, evaluate, release. Everything from here — pricing, incidents, regulators, rivals — builds on it.
